info.name: WattSpot API (MongoDB)
info.description: Every WattSpot back-end route. Start the server with npm start (MONGODB_URI set in .env, and npm run seed run once), then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Run folders top to bottom: "Open start times" saves a free slotStart that the Bookings folder then uses.

exec: // Runs before every request. Works out tomorrow (Manila time) and a few test values.
const quarter = new Date(); quarter.setUTCDate(quarter.getUTCDate() + 1); quarter.setUTCHours(4, 15, 0, 0);
pm.test("Has price and stock", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("price_per_kwh"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("stock"); });

request.description: Also sends "total": 1 to prove the server ignores the browser's total. If this answers 409, the slot was taken: run folder 2 again for a new slotStart.
